paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: (left) and (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve .
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance, expressed as a percentage, of different Large Language Models (LLMs) across various scaling configurations. The horizontal axis contains the labels “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B,” representing the model sizes, and is ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the percentage of CoLeG-R-R (%), with a scale ranging from 0% to 80%, utilizing a linear scale. The tick labels are spaced at intervals of 10%, displaying values from 0 to 80 in increments of 10%. There are five bars, each corresponding to a specific configuration: “no SFT on D0” represented by a light blue bar with a value of approximately 62%, “+ SFT on D0” represented by a yellow bar with a value of approximately 68%, “+ SFT on D0, D1” represented by a pink bar with a value of approximately 64%, “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2” represented by a lavender bar with a value of approximately 73%, and “LLaMA-2-70B” represented by a dark pink bar with a value of approximately 71%.  The bars are not sorted, and none are visually emphasized.
